Today, Apple announced a major update to Final Cut Camera, along with updates to Pages, Keynote, Numbers, Pixelmator Pro, and Freeform. Below is an introduction to the new features.

Apple launches a new version of the "Creator Studio" app, but non-subscribers can also enjoy the new features

Apple today announced new features for its popular iWork suite—Pages, Keynote, and Numbers—while also bringing improvements to Pixelmator Pro and Freeform.

Some of the new features are exclusive to Apple Creator Studio subscribers, but there are also selected features available to all users. Below are all the new features listed by Apple Newsroom:

Pages, Keynote, Numbers

Apple stated that today's update adds the ability to ask Siri questions about Pages, Keynote, or Numbers and receive answers. It is not yet clear whether Siri AI is required, but it is highly likely. The update also enables the feature of "requesting access to shared presentations, documents, or spreadsheets." This feature makes collaboration more convenient, as file owners no longer need to actively initiate file sharing.

Pages for Mac adds Screen View, which can "optimize content for easier reading and focused writing." Numbers adds "trigonometric, statistical, and logical functions to solve complex problems in spreadsheets."

In addition, Apple Creator Studio subscribers can enjoy new templates and themes for the three iWork apps. For Keynote, the smart slide generation feature can automatically create images suited to specific presentations.

Pixelmator Pro

Pixelmator Pro for iPad gains the Select and Mask tool, previously only available on Mac. Both Mac and iPad versions add two template series for sports and motion types, as well as new templates for "launching new creative projects, businesses, or products."

In addition, a new Podcast category has been added, making it easier to create cover images that fit the dimensions of major Podcast platforms.

Freeform

Among the app updates this time, which new features attract you the most? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comment section.

Featured Mac and iPad accessories

  • 100W USB-C fast charging power adapter
  • tomtoc tablet protective sleeve bag, combining protection and style
  • Twelve South aluminum MacBook laptop stand
  • Anker USB-C hub with Ethernet, HDMI, SD and other ports
  • Baseus 10-foot USB-C cable, extending connection range
